notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy New Year![/h1]

May 2025 bring you nothing but joy and new experiences. Thank you for your interest in LEMURIA — your support is incredibly important!

[h2]The update for LEMURIA is now available![/h2]

[p]In this update:[/p]

[list]

[*][b]Localization issues fixed:[/b] The menu language now matches the selected subtitle language for Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese, Polish, Finnish, and Japanese, while for Turkish, it is set to English.

[*][b]Improved animations:[/b] Character head movements in cutscenes are now more natural.

[*][b]Added effects:[/b] Camera now reacts to actions such as hand-to-hand combat, melee weapon fights, jumps, rolls, and overcoming obstacles.

[*][b]Graphic improvements:[/b] The hairstyles of the main characters are now fuller and more voluminous.

[*][b]Cutscene controls in the Mature DLC have become more intuitive:[/b] The camera now retains the angle selected by the player, providing a more comfortable and natural viewing experience.

[/list]

[p]If anything in the game requires attention, leave your messages. It helps make it better.[/p]

notes.title: Radical update 1.7
notes.content:
Dear fans of unusual adventures! Version 1.7 has been published, in which a huge number of changes have been made:
[list]
[*] A new smoother and smarter camera. In addition, in safe locations and episodes, a special camera mode is enabled by default, in which you can control movement only with arrows or left stick, something like in Being Human, but with a more aggressive turn.
[*] New crosshair crosshair. Iron Sights simulation mode is enabled by default. At first glance, it may seem that it is much on the amateur. However, this mode allows you to visually control the activity of your own aiming. Let me remind you that the player can lose the aiming mode when taking damage. On easy difficulty levels never, on medium levels when taking damage to Health, on hard levels when taking any damage.
[*] New aiming mode. In the style of current trends, the camera position is moved further away from the character's head than before. This frees up space for viewing the battlefield, but at the same time increases the parallax between the firing point and the point of view, which requires special attention when firing a grenade launcher.
[*] The amount of damage is now independent of the difficulty level. However, the additional protection of the Player, which depends on the difficulty (with a coefficient from 0.5 on the hardest to 3.0 on the easiest), has been retained.
[*] New clearer and more contrasting on-screen indicators of enemies, etc.
[*] Health and other indicators are displayed on the screen permanently only if a critical value is reached. In other cases they show a new value and disappear after a while.
[*] Added Fatigue indicator. Fatigue is accumulated when running and rolling.
[*] Added weapon readiness indicator (for slow reloading weapons).
[*] Changed task indicator. Now it is a clearly visible inscription in the upper left corner of the screen, and its appearance is accompanied by a sound signal.
[*] Modified the skill of using cover. Now you can activate it without turning your face to the shelter, and the whole system works much more reliably.
[*] Increased the richness of colors of the picture, which can be adjusted.
[*] In MatureDLC added the ability to switch between cameras, which also gives some additional effects.
[/list]
[b]And don't forget that we need your good reviews.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657867/9d24cdbaeb27de4d4277f830427c544c9cc221c0.png[/img]

notes.title: LEMURIA: 33% off sale and 1.5 update
notes.content:
Dear friends, we invite everyone to buy the game this weekend at a discount of 33%. Also published Update 1.5. There are many changes in the game, here are just a few of them:

[h2]New Camera Mode[/h2]
The new Adventure Camera mode is a third-person camera, slowly following the Player's character and roughly repeating the trajectory of his movement. You can control it with only one hand via keyboard or LStick controller, which does not exclude a possibility to quickly look around with mouse or RStick if you wish. In combat this camera is of little use, so when equipping a weapon will switch to the standard TPS camera regardless of the settings.

Due to the significant inertia of this camera, the running speed when using it is limited to the speed of brisk jogging. This mode is currently considered experimental and is not enabled by default. It may take some time to get used to this camera, but there is a request to try it by all means and report your feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657867/6a2095cba1eb15e118037dd7e34c031fad72e6d3.png[/img]

[h2]Changes in gameplay design.[/h2]
[list]
[*] The size and height of most of the hotspots are made with the intention that they can be activated when using the Adventure mode of the camera without tilting or raising the direction of the camera gaze, that is, again, with one hand. The exception is some secrets, to find which you have to move the cursor.
[*] The speed of running now depends on the surrounding space. The maximum it is in open places with a smooth hard surface, and minimal in the doorway.
[/list]

[h2]Performance and design[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized performance on open locations.
[*] Changed environment design in Illusory Reality.
[*] At image quality Good and below, peak CPU usage during firefights has been reduced by several times.
[*] The DJ menu buttons in the club are clearly illuminated when you switch to them, which is important when playing with a controller.
[/list]

[h2]Other, but no less important.[/h2]
[list]
[*] The camera behavior and dialogue dynamics in some of the MatureDLC scenes (currently in the motel and Kim's lair) have been made more varied and sensual. This is a work in progress and will be completed within the next week.
[*] Escape from the balcony on the narrow, wet wall in the Asian Quarter now takes place as a cutscene.
[*] The Hide skill is now available at any difficulty level.
[*] Lots of other changes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657867/379fd670ef489ce064e5ee7f54a6496766a20cc7.png[/img]

[b]Thanks to everyone who helped with feedback and support for this update![/b]

notes.title: LEMURIA: update 1.4.3
notes.content:
Dear friends, update 1.4.3 has been published. The game has been seriously upgraded:

[h2]Update 1.4[/h2]
Changed the order of the chapters. Military adventures have been moved to the middle of the game. Now the action develops more evenly, the player is not thrown immediately into the center of military action, and are prepared for it gradually. The game now begins in a warm apartment with your favorite girl sitting on the bed. In fact, that was originally intended.

Added a special menu for viewing the list of tasks of the current mission. Many tasks have expanded explanations and pictures. Now at any time you can check and see if everything is done, if all the possible characters were able to talk to. Also, these lists are a great help to understand what is happening and what to do, as keeping in mind all the previous events is not interesting for everyone. It all became a bit like an RPG, but without the hated grind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657867/9be81272edaca85e59c50f2f8a46692ff111b6e8.png[/img]

Increased the sprint speed of the characters by 30%. Now it is within the results of very trained athletes. But fans of slower running can still adjust this in the settings Customization--Actors.

Significantly redesigned the location of the 3rd floor of the clinic. Removed most of the doors in the aisles, made a passageway between the corridors, so you do not have to run from end to end every time. Several times increased the striking power of the baseball bat. Stephanie no longer gets into fights, only taking pictures.

Fixed the overview camera toggle in the Illusory Reality prison not happening in some settings.

Added a button to close it in the Inventory menu. Not really needed there, but very handy.

[h2]Update 1.4.3[/h2]
Radically increased contrast of captions in highlighted interface elements. Fixed a chain of transitions between them when controlling without a mouse (keyboard or controller).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657867/379fd670ef489ce064e5ee7f54a6496766a20cc7.png[/img]
[b]Thanks to all of you, who helped with your feedback and support to get this update released![/b]

notes.title: LEMURIA: Mature DLC
notes.content:
This DLC adds light erotic content to the main game, which contains several scenes and dialogue for audiences over the age of 18.
[h2]Changes made[/h2]
The DLC is not a dating or sex simulator, it embellishes and, in some cases, clarifies the existing story with erotic scenes and accompanying dialogue. These changes are made in the following chapters:
[list][*]Soldiers of Sand (Peacekeepers Bunker)
[*]The Room for Me and My Death
[*]Top floor mystery (1st and 2nd floors) 3 scenes
[*]The Tao of Microcredit (Kim's Lair) How Kim was killed
[*]The Tao of Microcredit (Labyrinth) 3 Scenes
[*]Nets of Sansara (Prison) 2 options[/list]
[h2]Using[/h2]
Upgrade the main game to version 1.2.0 or higher and assign [b]Actors / Nudity --> Mature[/b] in the settings. Also keep an eye on the dialogues and choose the appropriate options.
[h2]Warning[/h2]
All actors are over 18 years old. Content is intended for an audience over the age of 18 only.
[h2]Important[/h2]
If you do not have access to this DLC, check your account settings. If this does not help either, please contact Steam Technical Support. DLC is published the same way in all regions, and the rest is out of our hands.

notes.title: LEMURIA launched!
notes.content:
LEMURIA is a 3rd person adventure shooter with gunfights, dialogue, and numerous cutscenes, set against a backdrop of massive street riots and the beginning of a deadly epidemic. The gameplay is classic 3-person shooter, interspersed with dialogue and hotspot activation.

Guns, girls, cars, gold, uranium and wads of money - well, what else? Maybe an SSD-drive with stolen digital coins? No? Well then the grand prize is to get out of all this alive! When civilization begins to collapse and its laws are no longer in effect, all the problems arising have to be solved by new methods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657867/d22d776980ee87501246c3c5e47358ce91565c14.png[/img]

[h2]Main characters[/h2]
The main characters of the game, unemployed veteran [i][b]Alex[/b][/i] and aspiring spy [i][b]Kanta Anora[/b][/i], begin their journey to the African country [b]Lemuria[/b], each for their own reason, each from their own end of the world, each in their own way. What they will become--friends, enemies, lovers--time will tell. 

[i][b]Alex[/b][/i] will have to use the skills he learned in the army more than once on the way to his dream, and [i][b]Kanta[/b][/i] is capable of (and most likely will) arrange Armageddon when performing any, even the simplest task. 
[h2]Music[/h2]
The game uses music by two well-known authors - [i][b]Chris Onyak[/b][/i] and [i][b]John Leonard French[/b][/i]. A special mixing system allows the musical background to smoothly adjust to gameplay changes.
[h2]AI[/h2]
NPC AI can attack, retreat, shoot from cover, search for medical supplies and ammo, unite into groups and scatter in different directions, overcome obstacles and wait out of sight of the enemy. And all this without preconceived triggers, making every battle unique and replayable.
[h2]Customizability[/h2]
The game has a large number of customizable parameters, let's stop at just a few.

You can customize the duration and intensity of the firefights, the degree of protection of the Player and the strength of the weapon, or just choose rom the prepared presets.

With a few clicks of the settings, the game's visuals can be altered to range from a [i]prim melodrama[/i] for the whole family to a shamelessly licentious [i]VHS action movie[/i] from the 80s.

The hardness of the image on the screen can vary from crisp TV camera to soft film. The camera rotation speed and inertia can be changed even during gameplay, by entering the Main Menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657867/15f1a7bd198e13eba30b18303d2ce9d1590161c8.png[/img]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
The player can adjust the ratio of firefights to dialogue time, as well as the complexity of these firefights, according to his preferences. It should be noted that in any case, tactical decisions will be more important than marksmanship. It is also important to know that this game does not encourage camping and fights it by increasing the visibility and damage taken. 

The gameplay is made as varied as possible, and in each new location the player is likely to have to find new tactics. With the settings set correctly, the game will move on to the next stage 10 seconds before you get bored with the current stage.
[h2]Key Features[/h2]
[list][*]Alternating playing as two completely different main characters avoids monotony;
[*]Maximum realistic look;
[*]Advanced enemy AI;
[*]Dynamic, replayable battles whose outcome depends not only on accurate shooting, but also on tactical decisions;
[*]Cinematic cutscenes;
[*]Diverse enemies and companions;
[*]Realistic uncompromising stealth;
[*]Interesting live dialogues;
[*]Varied locations;
[*]The player doesn't just go from point to point for a plot-imposed goal, but can solve annoying social problems along the way, such as aggressive migrants, bad medicine, and high loan rates;
[*]Music by such masters as [i][b]Chris Onyak[/b][/i] and [i][b]John Leonard French[/b][/i] dynamically adapted to the gameplay.[/list]
[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
In addition to uncompromising firefights and saving another "[i]demoiselle en détresse[/i]", the player is treated to a fair amount of stealth and immersion into the depths of Kanta's subconscious in a fantasy reality. 

This game is fine entertainment for a few evenings, giving you the opportunity to shoot, talk, wander through a magical jungle and maybe do something else...
